title: Replace ws5_per_profile_test.dart's tautological payload-format assertions with real NotificationGateway verification
why: None of the 3 tests in the 'notification payload format' group ever construct a NotificationGateway or call scheduleDailyReminderForProfile/scheduleStreakAlertForProfile (confirmed: no NotificationGateway( appears anywhere in this file). Two of the three just re-interpolate the same '$dailyReminderPayload:$profileId' formula the source uses and compare it to a literal, or hand-write a `parts` list and assert facts about the literal they just wrote three lines earlier -- these can never fail regardless of what NotificationGateway actually does, so despite the docstring's claim to verify "per-profile payload format", they add file weight without adding protection. The real protection already exists properly (mocked zonedSchedule + captureAny) in the sibling notification_gateway_test.dart:320-416 outside this batch, which is why this is hygiene/redundancy (P3) rather than a live coverage gap.
recommendation: Either delete these two redundant tests (coverage already exists in notification_gateway_test.dart) or rewrite them to construct a NotificationGateway with a mocked FlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin and assert on the captured `payload:` argument from scheduleDailyReminderForProfile, matching this file's own '(good)' ID-allocation tests which do call the real functions.
acceptance_criteria: Remaining payload-format tests in this file (if kept) invoke NotificationGateway rather than re-deriving the expected string independently.
Red-first check: temporarily change the separator/format in notification_gateway.dart's per-profile payload construction and confirm whichever tests remain go red.

corrections: Core defect confirmed (no NotificationGateway( construction in file; cited asserts are self-computed tautologies). But the 'real protection at notification_gateway_test.dart:320-416' citation is wrong — that range covers non-profile scheduleDailyReminder. The actual per-profile payload test is at lines 1044-1073 ('embeds profileId in payload'). Finding and P3 severity still stand.

The supporting claim that real coverage exists at 'notification_gateway_test.dart:320-416' cites the wrong range — that span tests the non-per-profile `scheduleDailyReminder`, not per-profile. Actual per-profile payload coverage (which does exist, confirming real protection is elsewhere) is at lines 981-1300 (`scheduleDailyReminderForProfile`/`scheduleStreakAlertForProfile` groups). Doesn't change the tautology verdict itself.
